title: Grace Apartments D8-09, Tatu City
address: Tatu City, Ruiru, Kiambu County, Kenya
description: A fully furnished two-bedroom apartment in Tatu City, Ruiru, available for short stays. The kitchen is fully fitted, with a dishwasher, washing machine and a breakfast bar for four. The living room is furnished, the main bedroom has an en suite bathroom, and the second bedroom has its own separate toilet and bathroom. A balcony looks out over the courtyard and a green park. Internet is included.
